component.name: BottomBar
component.script:
sub init() m.top.translation = [96, 956] m.items = [] m.nodes = [] end sub
sub build() m.top.removeChildrenIndex(m.top.getChildCount(), 0) m.items = [] m.nodes = [] x = 0 ' Keep pills clear of the painting credit on the right. maxInputsRight = 980
if m.top.isTV and m.top.inputs <> invalid for each inp in m.top.inputs glyph = "pkg:/images/ui/ic_hdmi.png" if inp.id = "tvinput.dtv" then glyph = "pkg:/images/ui/ic_livetv.png" p = m.top.createChild("FrostPill") p.deep = m.top.deep p.glyph = glyph p.text = inp.name if x + p.width > maxInputsRight m.top.removeChild(p) exit for end if p.translation = [x, 0] m.nodes.Push(p) m.items.Push({ kind: "input", id: inp.id, name: inp.name }) x = x + p.width + 12 end for if m.items.Count() > 0 div = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") div.width = 1 div.height = 36 div.color = WithAlpha(LumenTheme().white, 0.35) div.translation = [x - 2, 14] x = x + 20 end if end if
actions = [ { kind: "sleep", glyph: "ic_sleep", tv: false } { kind: "picture", glyph: "ic_picture", tv: true } { kind: "edit", glyph: "ic_edit", tv: false } { kind: "off", glyph: "ic_power", tv: true } ] for each a in actions if m.top.isTV or not a.tv p = m.top.createChild("FrostPill") p.deep = m.top.deep p.round = true p.glyph = "pkg:/images/ui/" + a.glyph + ".png" p.translation = [x, 0] m.nodes.Push(p) m.items.Push({ kind: a.kind }) x = x + 64 + 12 end if end for m.top.count = m.items.Count() if m.top.focusIndex >= m.items.Count() then m.top.focusIndex = 0 onFocus() end sub
sub onFocus() for i = 0 to m.nodes.Count() - 1 m.nodes[i].focused = (m.top.active and i = m.top.focusIndex) end for end sub
sub onDeep() for each n in m.nodes n.deep = m.top.deep end for end sub
function current() as object if m.items.Count() = 0 then return invalid return m.items[m.top.focusIndex] end function
function centerOf(i as integer) as float n = m.nodes[i] return 96 + n.translation[0] + n.width / 2 end function
function focusCenterX() as float if m.nodes.Count() = 0 then return 960 return centerOf(m.top.focusIndex) end function
function indexNearestX(x as float) as integer best = 0 bestD = 99999 for i = 0 to m.nodes.Count() - 1 d = Abs(centerOf(i) - x) if d < bestD then bestD = d : best = i end for return best end function
